summary: CERO Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. issued a convertible promissory note with a $400,000 purchase price and $500,000 principal face value to Keystone Capital Partners, LLC, under which up to $1,000,000 may be borrowed. The note bears 10% interest, matures April 27, 2027, and is convertible into common stock at a conversion price equal to the lesser of $0.05 or 80% of the average of the five lowest intraday trading prices over the prior 20 days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The company must file a resale registration statement. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
